channel.title: Refrigerated & Frozen Foods - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Refrigerated & Frozen Foods (refrigeratedfrozenfood.com)

item.title: Boar's Head Debuts Greek Yogurt Dessert Dips
item.description: While Boar's Head is best known for its premium meats and cheeses, the introduction of these Greek yogurt-based dessert dips represent the brand's continued evolution, extending its legacy of craftsmanship and culinary innovation into a new category within the deli.

item.title: Signode Advances End-of-Line Automation for Packaging Producers
item.description: Building on decades of experience in empty container and rigid packaging, the company is responding to upstream operations.

item.title: Charcuterie Artisans Grows Through Acquisition, $12M Manufacturing Expansion
item.description: Now the largest charcuterie manufacturer in the U.S., the company will have capacity for 50+ million pounds of production by the end of 2026.

item.title: Tyson’s Nuggets of Love Return for Valentine’s Day
item.description: With 10 grams of protein per serving, what's not to love?

item.title: Silk Debuts New Plant-Based Protein Milk with Complete Protein
item.description: Silk Protein meets this growing demand with a new option that delivers the highest protein content of any refrigerated plant-based milk on shelves today.

item.title: NFRA Names 2026 Class of First Penguin Leadership Program Participants
item.description: Named after the “First Penguin” theory—often used to describe those willing to be the first to test uncharted waters amid unknown risk, and lead others—the program recognizes individuals who demonstrate leadership potential.

item.title: DSI Finishes Expansion of Frain Industries Manufacturing, Warehouse Site
item.description: The new facility enhances Frain’s capabilities in packaging and processing equipment solutions, expanding its ability to refurbish, integrate and deliver equipment to manufacturers nationwide.

item.title: Joyce Farms Launches Signature Angus Heritage Beef Program
item.description: The program will replace Joyce Farms' limited 100% grass-fed Aberdeen Angus Heritage Beef line, allowing the company to better meet demand while preserving its hallmark Nothing Added Ever commitment and third-party animal welfare certifications.

item.title: New Eriez Kit to Support Food Safety Retail Compliance
item.description: Developed in response to escalating food safety and quality demands—particularly within UK and European retail supply chains— to deliver exceptional inspection accuracy, traceability and reliability.

item.title: Kevin's Natural Foods Debuts Limited-Time Game Day Flavors
item.description: Three new options bring the excitement of game day food with high-quality ingredients and five-minute prep.
